fact: Bill no. 25/2026 on the protection of critical information infrastructure and digital security, dated 20 August 2026, provides for the creation of a National Cybersecurity Authority with legal personality (Article 6), CII operator programmes and 24-hour incident notification; a bill, noted as a draft.
title: Projet de loi n°25/2026 – Assemblée nationale du Sénégal : Protection des Infrastructures d'Information critiques et sécurité numérique
